meta.name: add-tavily-tool
meta.description: Add Tavily Search and Extract as keyless remote MCP tools for selected NanoClaw agent groups. Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加免密钥的搜索与网页提取能力到智能体组
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 NanoClaw 管理智能体，希望它们能直接搜索网页和提取内容
copy.tagline_en: Add keyless web search and extraction to your agent groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage NanoClaw agents and want them to search the web without an API key.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会为选定的 agent 组安装并配置 Tavily 的搜索和提取工具,这些工具无需 API 密钥即可使用。Claude 还会设置升级提示,以便免费额度用尽时引导用户添加付费密钥。
howto.when: 当用户要求为 agent 安装 Tavily 网络搜索或网址提取功能,且没有提供 API 密钥时,此技能会接管。

say.text: 给 agent 组添加 Tavily 搜索,不用 API 密钥。
say.note: Claude 会检查并安装必要的桥接器。

say.text: 帮我给某个 agent 安装 Tavily 的网址提取功能,无密钥。
say.note: Claude 会注册 tavily 服务器并重启组。

say.text: 为选定的 agent 组配置无密钥 Tavily 工具。
say.note: Claude 会询问具体组名并开始配置。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will set up Tavily search and extract for chosen agent groups with no API key required, and prep an upgrade prompt for when the free quota ends.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to install Tavily web search or URL extraction for an agent without providing an API key.

say_en.text: Add Tavily search to my agent group without an API key.
say_en.note: Claude will check the manifest and install the bridge.

say_en.text: Install Tavily's URL extract for an agent, keyless.
say_en.note: Claude will register the tavily server and restart the group.

say_en.text: Set up keyless Tavily tools for the selected agent groups.
say_en.note: Claude will ask which groups and configure them.
